observation: The exact mirror of the Sol piece. Front: the disc wall tapers inward as it rises, the opposite draft to Sol's and the ownership cue doing its job; the globe sits on the same seat collar at the same height. Top: concentric, one axis. Iso: same ball, same disc, same proportions. Outer surface smooth throughout -- the colour split is internal. No protrusion, no floating body, no missing or extra part, no visible intersection, no downward-facing surface added.
